risk_description: Offline-first data synchronization using 'Last Write Wins' strategy may result in silent data loss or complex merge conflicts when users modify the same entity across multiple devices or during prolonged offline periods, compromising data integrity.
root_cause: The inherent complexity of distributed state management and the reliance on client-side timestamps which may be drifted or manipulated.
mitigation_strategy: Implement a server-authoritative versioning system (Vector Clocks or strictly increasing version numbers) alongside the timestamp. Design a 'Conflict Queue' UI for users to manually resolve unmergeable data states rather than silently overwriting.
contingency_plan: Fallback to 'Online-Only' mode for critical write operations if sync reliability drops below 99.9%, while debugging the synchronization engine.
monitoring_trigger: Sync error rate > 2% or 'Data Conflict' exceptions in backend logs exceeding 10 per hour.

risk_description: Reliance on external Google Books API and OpenAI API without strict caching and circuit breakers will likely cause the backend to breach the 200ms P95 latency requirement during peak loads or provider throttling.
root_cause: External API latency is uncontrollable; the application architecture couples user-facing read operations directly to third-party API performance.
mitigation_strategy: Aggressive implementation of the Cache-Aside pattern using Redis (WI-READ-003). Implement decoupled background processing for non-blocking AI requests. Configure strict Polly policies with Fallback content (e.g., cached or static data) when external dependencies are slow.
contingency_plan: Disable AI recommendations temporarily via Feature Flags if P95 latency exceeds 500ms to preserve core app performance.
monitoring_trigger: Polly Circuit Breaker 'Open' state events or Google Books API response time > 500ms.

risk_description: Usage of Aurora Serverless v2 and OpenSearch Serverless presents a high risk of unexpected cost overruns due to improper auto-scaling configuration or inefficient query patterns in the RAG pipeline.
root_cause: Serverless pricing models are volume-based; inefficient loops in embedding generation or unoptimized SQL queries in the monolith can trigger massive scaling events.
mitigation_strategy: Implement strict AWS Budgets and cost anomaly detection alarms. Configure maximum ACU (Aurora Capacity Units) limits. Batch embedding generation jobs to run during off-peak hours to manage OpenSearch indexing costs.
contingency_plan: Migrate from Serverless to Provisioned Instances for DB and Search if monthly costs exceed budget by 20% for two consecutive months.
monitoring_trigger: Projected monthly bill exceeds 80% of budget within the first 10 days of the billing cycle.

risk_description: Flutter background execution restrictions on iOS and Android (Battery Optimization) may kill the background synchronization service or reading timer, leading to inaccurate reading logs.
root_cause: Aggressive OS-level battery management kills background processes that do not adhere to strict platform specific foreground service requirements.
mitigation_strategy: Utilize `workmanager` for periodic sync tasks and `flutter_background_service` for the timer. Save timer state timestamps to Isar immediately on start/pause to allow state reconstruction if the app is killed.
contingency_plan: Implement a 'Recovery Logic' UI that asks the user to confirm the end time if the app detects a non-clean termination of a reading session.
monitoring_trigger: User reports of 'lost reading time' or discrepancies between local start time and session duration.

risk_description: App Store and Play Store webhook integration for subscription lifecycle management is brittle; missed webhooks (Renew/Cancel) will cause database state drift and incorrect user feature access.
root_cause: Webhooks are fire-and-forget; network blips or backend downtime during webhook receipt results in lost events if not properly queued.
mitigation_strategy: Direct webhooks to Amazon SQS first (buffer layer) before processing. Implement a nightly reconciliation job that polls the Apple/Google APIs to verify the status of all active subscriptions against the database.
contingency_plan: Provide a manual 'Restore Purchases' button in the mobile app that forces a client-side receipt validation to correct backend state.
monitoring_trigger: Discrepancy detected by reconciliation job > 1% of total user base.

risk_description: Failure to strictly enforce Modular Monolith boundaries in .NET solution may lead to tight coupling between 'Reading' and 'Monetization' modules, creating a distributed ball of mud that is impossible to test or refactor.
root_cause: Lack of architectural enforcement tools allowing developers to add direct project references between feature modules instead of using the Shared Kernel or MediatR.
mitigation_strategy: Implement Architecture Unit Tests (ArchUnitNET) in the CI pipeline to fail builds if domain layer dependencies violate the strict concentric circle architecture rules.
contingency_plan: Schedule a dedicated 'Refactoring Sprint' if code complexity metrics (Cyclomatic Complexity) exceed defined thresholds.
monitoring_trigger: SonarQube architecture violation alerts or circular dependency warnings during build.
